comparison_unit: Counterfactual pair; its two cases are not independent observations

independent_matched_cache_injection.acceptance_rule: Exact full-logit equality on this fixed backend/dtype

native_chunked_no_fusion_vs_full_prefill.interpretation: Measures chunking/backend rounding, not C2C influence

direction_rule: Literal numeric sign, with no statistical-significance or practical-effect threshold

donor_competent_subset.criterion: Donor full-context forced A/B choice correct for both twins; correctness does not require a greedy A/B token

limits: All cases, including donor failures and adverse cache effects, remain in the primary results.
Private-input fusion deliberately departs from the trained shared-context setup.
Forced-choice probabilities condition on A/B; full-vocabulary mass and greedy behavior can disagree.
The donor-competent subset is a separately labelled conditional description, not a replacement sample.
No p-values, confidence intervals, universal fidelity rate or subjective-continuity inference are supplied.

runtime.latency_scope: Includes native prefill, cache copies and instrumentation; not a throughput benchmark
runtime.numerical_scope: Fixed backend and dtype; no cross-device bitwise equivalence claim

scope: Descriptive results on twelve fixed synthetic pairs; not a benchmark reproduction or identity test

validation.source_and_weight_authentication: Not repeated by this summary-only validator
